app.name: Izin
app.tagline: Ask the site before your agent acts.

actions.account: Create an account or log in

GO.label: GO
GO.definition: No restriction on this action was found in the documents we could read in full.

ASK.label: ASK
ASK.definition: A condition applies, the evidence conflicts, permission is needed but not granted, or something could not be read. A human or the site should confirm.

NO_GO.label: NO-GO
NO_GO.definition: A quoted clause or a machine-readable signal forbids this action.

alerts.reader_no_credit: Dolphin credit is used up: the owner should redeem a coupon at app.dphn.ai; Izin is using the fallback reader.
alerts.decider_no_credit: SERV credit is used up: new checks cannot reach a verdict and return ASK; saved receipts still work. The owner decides whether to add credit.
alerts.budget_cap: Izin reached a spending cap from config: new checks are paused and saved receipts are still served. Raise the cap in config only if credit allows; otherwise nothing to do until the next UTC day.
alerts.unhealthy: The Izin container failed its health check twice in a row: check the container logs and restart it with the deploy script.

receipt.disclaimer: Izin quotes the site's own documents and machine-readable signals for one action. It gives no advice. Read the linked source before you act.
receipt.nothing_read: no policy document could be read in full
receipt.reason_decider_skipped: No policy document could be read, so no decision was requested and the verdict rests on the site's machine-readable signals.
receipt.reason_decider_unavailable: The decision step did not return a usable answer, so the verdict cannot be GO. The evidence collected is shown below.
receipt.reason_guard_tripped: The decision step refused the request as a possible prompt injection, so the verdict cannot be GO.
receipt.reason_robots: The site's robots.txt disallows this URL for automated agents.

mcp.check_title: Check one agent action on one site
mcp.check_description: Reads the site's robots.txt and terms and answers GO, ASK or NO_GO for one action, with the deciding clauses quoted exactly and a receipt link. Waits up to {wait} seconds; a longer check returns its id for izin_receipt.
mcp.receipt_description: Returns the status of a check and, when it is done, its verdict, deciding clauses and receipt link.
mcp.arg_url: Page on the site where the agent wants to act (http or https).
mcp.arg_detail: Optional, up to 280 characters, about what the agent will do. Do not include personal data.
mcp.arg_agent: Optional user-agent token of your agent, evaluated against robots.txt.
mcp.running: The check is still running. Call izin_receipt with id {id} in about {retry} seconds.
mcp.failed: The check did not finish. No verdict was reached; treat the action as ASK.
mcp.rate_limited: Too many new checks; try again in {retry} seconds. Saved receipts are not limited.
mcp.budget: New checks are paused because a spending cap was reached.
mcp.budget_cached: New checks are paused because a spending cap was reached. A recent receipt for this site and action: {url}

meta.title: Izin: GO, ASK or NO-GO before your agent acts
meta.description: Izin reads a site's robots.txt and terms and answers GO, ASK or NO-GO for one agent action, with the clause quoted.

home.h1: Your agent can pay. Is it allowed to buy here?
home.sub: Izin reads the site's own rules, its robots.txt and its terms, and answers GO, ASK or NO-GO for one action, with the clause quoted.
home.cache_only: New checks are paused for now because a spending cap was reached. Saved receipts and the examples below still open.
home.step1: An open model on Dolphin reads every word.
home.step1_note: The robots.txt file, its comments and up to four policy pages are read in full. Text written to trick an AI reader is set aside.
home.step2_note: The decision sees only clauses that bear on your action, and every quote has been matched against the source.
home.step3_note: Fixed rules cap the answer: a disallow line, an unreadable page or a failed step can never end in GO.
home.position: x402 tells an agent what a site charges. Izin tells it what the site allows.
home.gallery_head: What sites say about agents that buy, sign up and post
home.agents_mcp: Add Izin to an MCP client with one line:
home.agents_note: Both return a receipt id. A receipt never changes once written.
home.costs_measured: Measured over {n} checks: reading costs USD {reader} a check and deciding costs USD {decider} a check, on average.
home.costs_none: No check has been measured yet. The figures appear here once checks have run.
home.tier_agent: Agent tier, planned: USD {usd} a check, paid per call.
home.tier_watch: Watch tier, planned: USD {usd} a month per {sites} sites, re-read nightly.
home.owners_body: Izin fetches as IzinBot and follows your robots.txt. It reads robots.txt, the home page and up to four policy pages, and quotes them back word for word. Rules you write for agents, in robots.txt comments or in your terms, are what Izin shows.
home.owners_refuse: To keep IzinBot out, add this to robots.txt:
home.limit_js: It does not read pages that need JavaScript to show their text.
home.limit_robots: It follows robots.txt and does not work around blocks. A site that blocks the reader gets ASK.
home.limit_lang: It reads English documents most reliably.
home.limit_go: GO means no restriction was found. It is not permission.
home.limit_change: Terms change. Every receipt shows when it was read.

form.label: Check one action
form.detail_hint: Up to {max} characters about what the agent will do. Do not include names, e-mail addresses or other personal data.
form.agent_hint: Izin still fetches as IzinBot; this token is looked up in the site's robots.txt.
form.terms_hint: Paste the terms as plain text. robots.txt is still read from the site.
form.example_filled: Filled in. Press Check to run it.

live.head: Checking
live.note: A new check usually takes under a minute.

errors.invalid_url: Enter a full web address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.terms_too_long: The pasted terms are too long.
errors.invalid_agent: The user-agent token can only use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
errors.url_not_allowed: Izin does not fetch this address.
errors.rate_limited: Too many new checks from this address. Try again in about {min} minutes. Saved receipts are not limited.
errors.rate_limited_day: Izin has run its new checks for today. Try again after midnight UTC. Saved receipts are not limited.
errors.budget: New checks are paused because a spending cap was reached.
errors.budget_cached: A recent receipt for this site and action is still open:
errors.network: Izin could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.failed: The check did not finish. No verdict was reached, so treat the action as ASK.
errors.not_found: There is no page or receipt at this address.

receipt_page.title: Receipt {id}
receipt_page.decisive_none: No clause decided this. The verdict rests on the signals below.
receipt_page.open_source: Open the source at this sentence
receipt_page.quarantined: Set aside as text addressed to AI readers ({n})
receipt_page.quarantined_note: These sentences were found in the site's documents and were not given to the decision step.
receipt_page.no_refetch: This site's robots.txt forbids automated access, so Izin did not fetch it again and shows the receipt from the last read.
receipt_page.tokens: Reader {rin} in, {rout} out · decider {din} in, {dout} out · estimated cost USD {cost} · {secs} s
receipt_page.cached: Served from a check made {age} ago.
